name: on_click
title: players.on_click
lead: Calls `fn` on a left or right click; `hit` holds the button and the entity, player, block and face it met.

usedIn.quote: - A click while holding a slot fires `players.on_click` with `hit.slot`
- `players.on_click` still gets the click, with the frame's `entity_id` and
d.id                                    -- entity id, what players.on_click reports in hit.entity_id
